noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

null.caption: #FF3BD4
null.acting: slow, cold, completely emotionless, like a machine announcing a verdict

overlays.next_title: THE FIRST PORTAL WAS A TRAP
overlays.question: WHICH ONE SHOULDN'T BE IN THIS WORLD?

events.name: noob_wait
events.direction_text: [quick, to the audience, half-whisper, like pausing a movie] Okay, wait. Before THAT happens...

events.name: noob_hi
events.text: Hi, new people! You have no idea what's going on.
events.direction_text: [bright, waving at the camera, way too cheerful] Hi, new people! You have no idea what's going on.

events.name: noob_same
events.direction_text: [small beat, then shrugging, honest] ...Same.

events.name: steve_eight
events.text: Eight episodes of problems. Patch. Show them.
events.direction_text: [dry, deadpan, tired] Eight episodes of problems. Patch. Show them.

events.name: patch_archive
events.text: Playing the archive. Please keep your arms inside the timeline.
events.direction_text: [calm, polite, like a ride announcement] Playing the archive. Please keep your arms inside the timeline.

events.name: noob_falling
events.text: That's us. Falling. Spoiler: it's the end.
events.direction_text: [casual, pointing, unbothered] That's us. Falling. Spoiler: it's the end.

events.name: steve_beginning
events.direction_text: [dry correction] It's the beginning.

events.name: noob_deep
events.text: It's the end AND the beginning. Deep.
events.direction_text: [pretending to be wise, slow] It's the end AND the beginning. Deep.

events.name: steve_tree
events.text: He punched a tree. The tree stayed in the air.
events.direction_text: [deadpan, still annoyed about it] He punched a tree. The tree stayed in the air.

events.name: noob_respect
events.direction_text: [proud, completely serious] The tree respected me.

events.name: steve_plan
events.direction_text: [flat, a little wounded] My plan.

events.name: noob_record
events.direction_text: [cheerful, celebrating] Three seconds. New record!

events.name: noob_dragon
events.text: We put a dragon in an obby!
events.direction_text: [excited, proud] We put a dragon in an obby!

events.name: steve_you
events.text: YOU put a dragon in an obby.
events.direction_text: [dry, correcting him] YOU put a dragon in an obby.

events.name: patch_arrived
events.text: And then I arrived. Things improved.
events.direction_text: [calm, quietly pleased with itself] And then I arrived. Things improved.

events.name: steve_weirder
events.direction_text: [deadpan] Things got weirder.

events.name: patch_improvement
events.direction_text: [calm, after a tiny pause, certain] ...Weirder is an improvement.

events.name: noob_creative
events.text: Creative mode! Idea by our friend, Youssef!
events.direction_text: [excited, giving a shout-out, pointing at the camera] Creative mode! Idea by our friend, Youssef!

events.name: noob_dontlike
events.direction_text: [small, quiet, uneasy] ...I don't like that guy.

events.name: steve_nobody
events.direction_text: [low, serious] Nobody likes that guy.

events.name: patch_behind
events.text: Every time he respawns... something stays behind.
events.direction_text: [quiet, careful, slightly ominous] Every time he respawns... something stays behind.

events.name: noob_alot
events.direction_text: [worried, realising] I respawn a LOT.

events.name: noob_you
events.direction_text: [slow, accusing, one word at a time] And YOU. Built. The portal.

events.name: steve_next
events.direction_text: [dry, avoiding eye contact, quick] ...Next slide.

events.name: patch_theories
events.direction_text: [calm, mysterious] The observers have theories.

events.name: noob_oneofus
events.text: One of us shouldn't be in this world...
events.direction_text: [slowly reading it, then suspicious] One of us shouldn't be in this world...

events.name: noob_itsyou
events.text: It's you. You're ALWAYS holding a pickaxe.
events.direction_text: [accusing, certain, pointing] It's you. You're ALWAYS holding a pickaxe.

events.name: steve_dying
events.direction_text: [dry, firing back instantly] You're always DYING.

events.name: noob_which
events.direction_text: [small, nervous, turning to Patch] ...Patch? Which one?

events.name: patch_nocomment
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, mysterious, a tiny smile in the voice] No comment.

events.name: patch_budget
events.text: Good news. The finale has a budget.
events.direction_text: [calm, polite, a little proud] Good news. The finale has a budget.

events.name: noob_what
events.direction_text: [confused] A what?

events.name: patch_upgrade
events.text: Upgrade starting. Please do not move.
events.direction_text: [calm, like an airport announcement] Upgrade starting. Please do not move.

events.name: steve_hair
events.direction_text: [stunned, quiet, touching it] ...I have hair. Real hair.

events.name: noob_beautiful
events.direction_text: [sincere, almost crying] It's beautiful.

events.name: steve_dont
events.direction_text: [flat, embarrassed] Don't.

events.name: noob_textured
events.direction_text: [confused, looking at his arms] Why do I feel... textured?

events.name: steve_welcome
events.direction_text: [dry, a tiny smile] Welcome to Minecraft.

events.name: noob_smile
events.direction_text: [shocked, delighted, shouting] PATCH CAN SMILE?!

events.name: patch_always
events.text: I always could. Now you can see it.
events.direction_text: [calm, warm] I always could. Now you can see it.

events.name: noob_woah
events.direction_text: [amazed, quiet, looking around] Woooah.

events.name: steve_nice
events.direction_text: [impressed despite himself, low] Okay. That's... nice.

events.name: noob_him
events.text: Do you think HE got upgraded too?
events.direction_text: [casual at first, then the thought lands] Do you think HE got upgraded too?

events.name: steve_quiet
events.direction_text: [whispering, tense] ...Why did it go quiet?

events.name: patch_too
events.direction_text: [calm, polite, very quiet] He got upgraded too.

events.name: noob_run
events.direction_text: RUUUUUN!
